name: com.michaelo.oxgkit.actionsystem
description: The OxGKit is a system tool kit commonly used in game development based on Unity design (all are independent tools).

samples.description: Demonstrates ActionRunner pumped from MonoBehaviour Update: composing SequenceAction and ParallelAction from DelegateAction/DelayAction with delays and callbacks, then starting runs with RunAction.

Agent Skill (SKILL.md) that teaches AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, etc.) how to use the ActionSystem: ActionRunner update loops, default sequence/parallel/delay/delegate actions, and custom ActionBase authoring. Copy the skill folder into your agent's skills directory after import (see the sample's README).
